short: James Cook, British navigator of the Pacific.

short: The prehistoric stone monument on Salisbury Plain.

short: The New England minister who wrote about witchcraft.
note: The Boston Puritan minister whose The Wonders of the Invisible World (1693) defended the Salem witchcraft proceedings and described alleged demonic activity.
